name: Encore
tagline: See which friends are going to the same concerts and share seats to find each other.

awards: Most Likely to Become a Startup

problem: Concerts are social, but people do not know which friends will be there.
solution: A mobile app with friends, a local event feed, attending or interested status and optional seat sharing.
demo_moment: Team-described: mark a show as attending and spot friends' seats.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Likely to Become a Startup” among 217 submissions.
Team members had been at the same concerts without knowing.

lessons: A gap the team lived through makes a startup prize pitch credible.
